owner: Angelea McCullough, Founder of RMS Global Publishing
principle: Separate voluntary support from paid products and services. Never imply a contribution purchases Discord membership or tax-deductible charity status.

community_support.purpose: Voluntary support for Reset operating infrastructure

studio_services.purpose: Reset Media Virtual Studio paid production services

event_services.purpose: Produced events, workshops, sponsorship-related or event production services as separately defined offers

activation_rules: Use Stripe-hosted Payment Links or Checkout URLs only
Bind each environment variable to the matching Stripe product or support lane only
Do not reuse one payment link across support and paid service buckets
Do not activate until public route, product language, amount, refund/cancellation terms and fulfillment path are verified
Keep payment credentials and webhook secrets server-side
Payment success must not auto-grant Discord membership unless a separate platform-compliant entitlement design is explicitly approved
Normalized AOS events may record bucket, amount class, campaign and outcome, but never raw card data or Stripe secrets
